recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14411 unless someone separately wants to inspect historical STU3 publication artifacts outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-14411 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 change request to rename the StructureDefinition operation for generating snapshots from $generate to $snapshot.
initial_application: Jira records application in svn revision 13062. The original svn change predates the available Git source trail, but the first tracked new-build source commit already contains OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot with code snapshot and no StructureDefinition-generate entry.
additional_context: FHIR-13795 created/formalized the snapshot generation operation and documented the $generate versus $snapshot naming question. StructureDefinition is active in the current build, and later FHIR-41351 maintenance changed $snapshot semantics without renaming the operation. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting FHIR-14411 evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already has the StructureDefinition-snapshot OperationDefinition, $snapshot examples, an operation-list reference to OperationDefinition/StructureDefinition-snapshot, and an OID registry entry for the same URL; current-source search found no stale StructureDefinition $generate reference.

related_jiras.note: This predecessor issue defined the snapshot generation operation and its comments explicitly show the $generate versus $snapshot naming question resolved by FHIR-14411.
A later source commit modified $snapshot idempotence/affectsState wording while preserving the $snapshot operation identity.
